body:
Ordinary Circuit learning delivery can durably claim a completed task before discovering that the bounded learning actor is full or closed. That leaves an operation which was never submitted on the readback-only recovery path. Separately, the signed Evaluation reader currently accepts only a Training-prefix checkpoint, so it cannot revalidate the original Evaluation from a checkpoint that has already advanced to Selection or NextUse.

This candidate makes two reviewable changes on exact parent abf75d8e2097785b2ad01897c15a7531eebe6e44 (#5707):

- Reserve the existing actor's bounded capacity before the durable outbox claim. Keep that same permit through the existing post-claim original-source check. QueueFull/Closed before claim leave the outbox unchanged; loss after claim still requires original readback, never blind retraining. This carries forward the existing shared-framework reservation design.
- Validate the entire recovered learning history, reconstruct its exact original Training prefix, and require any retained Evaluation receipt to equal the original qualification result before contacting evidence owners. The owners still receive the full checkpoint head, and current-time trust, signature, and actor-separation checks remain mandatory.

Also add the explicit Arc<AgentdState> receiver type required by the existing typed caller scanner; no scanner or admission rule is relaxed. CALLERS.toml gains stronger validation-order markers and keeps the unassembled production caller sets empty.

Validation so far: git diff --check and just fmt pass; the original Root learning source-closure suite changes from 9 pass/1 error to 10/10 pass with the unchanged scanner. New native regressions exercise actual SQLite/actor capacity, lost responses without repeated work, completed Qualified and NoUpdate history readback after work expiry, and rejection of corrupted or substituted history before owner I/O. Native execution and fresh source-head CI are pending; added tests are not yet claimed as passing.

Scope: these fixes close concrete delivery/recovery defects. They do not create a production LearningIterationStageOwnerPortsV1 implementation, external original evidence-owner deployments, independently held training/evaluation custody, or evidence of learning benefit. Full ordinary production learning remains HOLD. No merge or activation is requested by this draft.
title: fix(agentd): preserve learning delivery and evaluation recovery
